channel.title: POECH ART Digital - Abstract Wall Art Ideas
channel.description: Abstract wall art ideas: close-up details of real hand-painted acrylic paintings, shown in digitally mocked-up rooms.

item.title: Jungle Swirl | Green and Yellow Abstract Wall Art Print
item.description: Green and yellow abstract wall art: green and yellow swirl around pale blocks with a splash of blue. A detail from Resonant Currents by POECH ART. Room shown is a digital mockup. The artwork is a close-up of a real hand-painted acrylic painting on aluminum.

item.title: Orange Core | Blue and Orange Abstract Wall Art Print
item.description: An orange burst glows at the center of blue rings. A blue and orange abstract wall art print taken from the POECH ART painting Calming Ripples. Room shown is a digital mockup. The artwork is a close-up of a real hand-painted acrylic painting on aluminum.

item.title: Scarlet Cobbles | Red Abstract Wall Art Print
item.description: Red abstract wall art print: pale tiles line up in diagonal rows across deep red. A close-up detail from the original POECH ART painting Radiant Echoes. Room shown is a digital mockup. The artwork is a close-up of a real hand-painted acrylic painting on aluminum.

item.title: Lemon Crossfire | Blue and Yellow Abstract Wall Art Print
item.description: Lemon yellow streaks cross deep blue and pale arcs. A blue and yellow abstract wall art print taken from the POECH ART painting Spiral Waves. Room shown is a digital mockup. The artwork is a close-up of a real hand-painted acrylic painting on aluminum.
